request.spec:
The sheet has a fiscal year start month (settings, 1 to 12, 1 unless set, not dated;
SETTING_CHANGED key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>; anything else is refused). A fiscal year is
named FY<yyyy> by the calendar year its first day falls in; show on each period the fiscal year its
from-date falls in. A year entry and a button generate that fiscal year's twelve monthly periods
exactly as the period generator does; show how many were made.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has a fiscal year start month (settings, 1 to 12, 1 unless set, not dated;
SETTING_CHANGED key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>; anything else is refused). A fiscal year is
named FY<yyyy> by the calendar year its first day falls in; show on each period the fiscal year its
from-date falls in. A year entry and a button generate that fiscal year's twelve monthly periods
exactly as the period generator does; show how many were made.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The fiscal year change is in, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**The setting**
- Each sheet now stores a fiscal year start month (new migration `V82__sheet_fiscal_start_month.sql`). It is 1 unless set and isn't dated.
- It's saved at `PUT …/settings/fiscal-start-month`, which accepts only whole numbers from 1 to 12. Anything else is refused and writes nothing.
- A successful save writes `SETTING_CHANGED … key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>` to the audit file.
- The settings screen has a field for it and shows the current value. A bad entry like `13` or `x` shows the settings error.
- Viewing the sheet as of a past date shows the month as it was set then, and cloning a sheet copies it.

**FY on each period**
- Each period row shows `FYyyyy` for the fiscal year its from-date falls in. A fiscal year is named by the calendar year of its first day. For example, with a start month of 4, a period starting 2025-12-20 shows FY2025.

**Generating a fiscal year**
- The periods screen has a year entry and a "Generate fiscal year" button, backed by `POST …/periods/generate-fy`.
- It reuses the existing monthly generator over the twelve months starting on the first of the start month. So it skips months whose name is taken or that overlap another period, and shows how many it made in the same count as the monthly generator.
- An invalid year shows the generate error.

The period FY label is worked out in the front end from the start month, which is why it follows the as-of view without a server change.
